openings.claim: Challenge magnetic necessity: magnetic success establishes an M→B instance, not B→M; weaker spare attraction establishes neither universal implication. Remove magnetic dependence using supplied bent/drilled strips forming a locating pocket bolted through existing slots: side/face capture, stops on unmarked regions, pivoting rear service gate. Cork takes up play; positive boundaries carry stroke loads. Open gate; withdraw by broad face or unmarked rear edge.
openings.discriminator: A geometrically feasible pocket could hold spare displacement ≤1 mm over twenty strokes despite 3 N magnetic release. Rival magnet/cork retention without positive capture depends on attraction/friction. Compare displacement and release during identical spare runs; rival failure is not assumed.
openings.probe: Compare ordinary magnet/cork retention and magnet-free pocket. Verify exposed marked 30 mm working edge, no added part entering marked stroke clearance, rails attached, and no drilling/cutting/heating/gluing plate or carriage. Mark/ruler references; three twenty-stroke spare runs per configuration, checking displacement throughout. Three timed removal/return checks each wearing thick gloves, without working-edge contact; log gate manipulation/seating failures within twenty-minute observation allowance.
openings.uncertainty: Unknown slot dimensions must accept M4; unknown strip width/thickness must allow bending/stiffness under unknown loads. Unmarked regions must allow opposing stops/face capture outside clearance, seating/play ≤1 mm. Supplied bolts/nuts must suffice for mounting/glove-operable gate; fabrication ≤80 minutes. Defeat: no compliant geometry, deformation, displacement >1 mm, edge contact, or removal/return >60 seconds. Insufficient comparison time leaves feasibility unestablished; time cap alone is not informative.

lineage.reason: Retains causal relation, complete rival comparison, declared uncertain fit, assumptions, defeats and resource caveat.

decision: Test only after compliant geometry/resource checks. Retention and serviceability remain proposed, undemonstrated; unknown resources do not relax constraints.
